description: This Java source file defines a utility class ApplicationContextListenerUtils that implements an application listener for ContextStartedEvent, initializing a SearchService bean when the Spring application context starts.

classes.name: ApplicationContextListenerUtils
classes.description: A utility class that listens for application context start events and initializes the search service.

methods.name: onApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles the ContextStartedEvent by retrieving the 'productSearchService' bean from the application context and calling its initService method.
